source: LROC NAC DTM APOLLO16 orthophoto NAC_DTM_APOLLO16_MOSAIC_50CM (0.5 m/px, resampled to 1 m) (Credit: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University)
frame: local east/north (m) of grid, node (i,j) at ((i-h)*spacing, (j-h)*spacing), h=(n-1)/2; affine fit max error 0.02 m
dark_rule: pixel dark if DN < 15.0 (= max(2, 0.08 x p95 of valid DN)); node observable if >= 90 % of its 100 m cell is valid and not dark AND never_lit_18y == 0
